skill_name: Explain why loyalty programs are an effective part of customer retention.
workflow: Loyalty programs are an effective part of customer retention because they help to build trust and long-term loyalty with customers. Through loyalty programs, companies can reward customers with discounts, free items, and other incentives that build trust and reinforce customer loyalty. By offering these rewards, companies can encourage customers to continue doing business with them and create brand loyalty.
